generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: professional logo variant artwork. The RIGHT emblem must repeat EXACTLY the same geometry in one uniform medium-light grey #b9bec2, with all counters completely transparent. No pure white ink at all. Each emblem must be approximately square with substantial strokes, clean vector-like boundaries and all negative spaces transparent. No background, no label, no text, no shadow, no gradient, no glow, no texture, no distressed edges, no tiny lines, no mockup. Both emblems should be crisp, beautifully balanced, and legible at 32 pixels. Fit each entire symbol within its own square half of a 2:1 canvas, margins around each and clear central gap.
